sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 6447.5 ± 45.8 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: L5: flow cytometry with fluorescent ligand K(5/6-FAM)-WKYMVm confirmed surface expression and ligand binding of FLAG-tagged FPR1 in HEK293 cells (surface_and_function). L6: internalization kinetics of 3xHA-tagged FPR1 in HL-60 cells matched wild-type, confirming trafficking is preserved.
sites.rationale: FPR1 is a class A GPCR with no signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1–26 extracellular and TM1 beginning at residue 27, leaving 26 residues of clearance from the TM boundary. Neither L4 nor L5 names a specific residue, but because the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus of FPR1 (the C-terminus, 306–350, is intracellular), a surface-displayed N-terminal tag can only reside at the prepend position (insert_after_residue = 0, residue_after = M1). Python verification confirms seq[0] = 'M'. L6 independently corroborates the same position with a 3xHA tag in a different cell line and paper, with trafficking preserved. L4/L5 (PMC12881670): HEK293 stable cell lines expressing N-terminally FLAG-tagged human FPR1 generated by HiFi assembly; L6 (PMC13181108): HL-60 cells expressing 3xHA-tagged FPR1 confirmed surface display and agonist-induced internalization indistinguishable from wild-type. FPR1 is a GPCR with no signal peptide; its N-terminus (residues 1–26) is the sole extracellular terminus, so any surface-displayed N-terminal tag must prepend before M1.

sources.claim: Receptors were N-terminal FLAG-epitope tagged by the use of the HiFi assembly protocol from New England Biolabs.

literature_notes: Seven ledger lines were evaluated. L4 and L5 (same paper, PMC12881670) explicitly describe N-terminal FLAG tagging of full-length membrane-anchored FPR1 with confirmed surface expression and ligand binding — these ground the sole surface site. L6 (PMC13181108) independently corroborates the N-terminal prepend position with a 3xHA tag and trafficking validation. L1, L2, L3 (PMC13198294) describe FlAsH tetracysteine insertions in ICL1 (T56–H57), ICL2 (T133–Q134), and ICL3 (L233–I234) respectively — all three are intracellular by the authoritative topology landmarks and are recorded in other_positions. L7 (PMC13198294) describes a C-terminal GFP fusion; the C-terminus (306–350) is intracellular and is also recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports an insertion in any of the four extracellular loops (ECL1 84–100, ECL2 163–205, ECL3 267–284) beyond the N-terminus, so no internal extracellular sites are proposed.
